editorial.blurb: Imee's Kitchen serves authentic Lebanese home cooking with generous portions and a warmth that extends from the kitchen to Nicole's gracious service.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask Nicole to help you choose a dish based on what you're craving—she's genuinely invested in making sure you get exactly what you want. Try a split bowl on your first visit to sample multiple items.

topDishes.note: Tender chicken with perfectly balanced spices
Fresh and integral to the balanced, satisfying meal
